full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph places four young men in the near foreground of a rough, open lane. They wear dark jackets, with light shirt collars and one narrow dark tie visible against the dense shadows. The man nearest the left edge stands slightly apart and closest to the camera, his hands behind his back and his face turned directly toward the lens. Three companions cluster just to his right, their postures casual and their expressions quietly alert. A fifth figure stands farther back near the right edge, partly separated from the central group. The ground is uneven and dusty, with a few indistinct objects scattered along the lane. A row of low weathered wooden buildings and sheds recedes on either side, their rooflines framing the central distance. On the right, a cluster of bicycles leans together close to the camera, their handlebars and wheels cutting narrow metallic arcs through the dark lower corner. Utility poles recede into the haze, including one tall pole tilted sharply near the middle-right. At left, a slender chimney sends a vast dark plume across the pale sky. The smoke swells overhead and drifts toward the center, making the upper half of the image feel as charged as the group below it. Far buildings and poles fade into a light gray atmospheric distance. The perspective is slightly wide and close, keeping the nearest faces prominent while letting the industrial surroundings remain legible. Coarse grain, deep blacks, soft midtones, and a bright overcast sky produce a candid documentary feel; the moment looks encountered on the street, with no polished pose or clean theatrical backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片把四位年轻男子放在粗糙开阔巷道的近前景。他们穿深色外套，浅色衬衫领口和一条窄深色领带从浓影中显出。最靠左的男子略与同伴分开，也最接近相机；他把手放在身后，正面转向镜头。其余三人聚在他的右侧，姿态随意，神情安静而警觉。第五道人影站在右边更远处，与中央群体稍有距离。地面不平且有尘土，巷道边散有少量难辨的物件。两侧一排低矮、风化的木楼和棚屋向远处退去，屋顶线围合中央纵深。右侧，一组自行车在相机附近相互靠着，车把与车轮在深色下角切出细窄的金属弧线。电线杆逐渐消失在薄霾里，其中一根高杆在画面中右部明显倾斜。左边细烟囱吐出一大片深色烟雾，横过苍白天空。烟向上膨大并飘向中央，使画面上半部与下方人物群同样充满力量。远楼与电杆隐入浅灰色空气距离。视角略广而近，让最近的人脸突出，同时保留工业环境的可辨性。粗颗粒、深黑、柔和中间灰与明亮阴天构成坦率的纪实感；这一刻像是街头偶遇，没有精心摆出的姿势或干净的戏剧布景。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white documentary photography with direct eye-level framing and a slightly wide, close perspective. Deep black clothing and structures anchor the foreground, while a pale overcast sky and smoke-filled distance preserve a full scale of gray. Grain and mild softness belong to the photographic surface; retain natural irregularities rather than sharpening every edge. Human forms can meet the camera openly, with informal spacing and uneven stances, while surrounding details continue to describe their location. Receding poles and rooflines establish depth, and one broad dark atmospheric shape can balance the smaller foreground silhouettes. Avoid polished studio separation: edges overlap, shadows merge, and some distant objects remain ambiguous. The composition should feel immediate and observational, relying on tonal weight, spatial tension, and the contrast between a large shifting sky and compact forms near the ground.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白纪实摄影采用平视直面构图和略广、贴近的视角。深黑衣物与构筑物压住前景，苍白阴天和充满烟霾的远方保留完整灰阶。颗粒与轻微软化属于摄影表面；保留自然不规则感，而非把每条边缘都锐化。人物可坦率地面对相机，间距不齐、站姿随意，周围细节仍持续交代其所处空间。后退的电杆与屋顶线建立纵深，一块宽阔的深色大气形体则能平衡地面附近较小的剪影。避免摄影棚式的精细分离：边缘会互相叠压，阴影会合并，有些远处物件保持含混。构图应有即时的观察感，依靠明暗重量、空间张力，以及大片流动天空与地面紧凑形体之间的对照。
theme_en: A black-and-white street portrait of four young men on a rough lane beneath factory smoke
theme_zh: 黑白街头照片中，四位年轻男子站在粗糙巷道上，身后升起工厂烟雾
name: Issei Suda
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
